batch1_character.numbers: Derive everything from the concept (Level, Band, Stage, Path, Grades, Aether Class, harmonizations set from the Fracture of Worlds tables and stated plainly; Isaac overrules any of it)
batch1_character.voice_approval: Only a voice line (a sentence describing the voice plus one sample line, approved with the card)
batch1_character.backstory: Rich lore, with held secrets (public history, private history, and sealed facts the page will not state)
batch1_character.art: Art first (Isaac's words: 'I give u art for characters etc and you make characters based on that art'): Isaac supplies the art and Natalie builds the character, and by extension other things, from it

batch2_art_first.read_from_art: All four: the full physical inventory; age, culture and place; mood, bearing and voice; power and aura hints
batch2_art_first.gaps: Stay close to what is drawn (invent nothing the art does not show; leave the rest null and log it)
batch2_art_first.art_for: All four: places and maps; items and gear; creatures and Well-spawn; techniques and effects
batch2_art_first.art_storage: You decide per image (Natalie asks where each one lives when it arrives)

batch3_improve_locations_factions.improve_post_return: Just the rewrite (his intent, voice, tense and person; no commentary; his post still wins)
batch3_improve_locations_factions.improve_targets: All four: body and blows (Blow Card); magic on the blow (display, signature, cost); voice and heat; continuity and rules
batch3_improve_locations_factions.locations: Only what scenes use (locations are written when a scene needs them and grow from play)
batch3_improve_locations_factions.faction_card: All four: wants and splits; procedures and seals; money and reach; a face and a front

batch4_items_creatures_villains_arcs.items: From art (if art exists it drives the item; otherwise one line)
batch4_items_creatures_villains_arcs.creatures: Written in the scene, filed after (invented in the writing; a bestiary entry made when it recurs)
batch4_items_creatures_villains_arcs.villains: By the card (a villain is a person: refusal, want, voice, numbers, backstory, sealed facts)
batch4_items_creatures_villains_arcs.arc_plan: All four: the Fronts and their clocks; anchor scenes and the ending; cast and their wants; seeds and plants
